title: Loader-verification nine-document reference set lands framework default shipment by mid-June 2026
body: By mid-June 2026 the agentic-AI loader-verification reference set lands as the canonical nine-document academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring-plus-workshop-consolidation-plus-workshop-extension bundle that the LangChain plus AutoGen plus CrewAI plus Haystack plus Pydantic AI maintainer cohort ships as the default verification surface from Friday's RC1 branch cuts, with the framework default-shipment commitment now sitting atop a triply-aged triply-cleared regulatory backdrop and the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday resumption opening a clean release-engineering execution window rather than a fresh verification question. A Monday Hugging Face Blog federal-holiday post reports the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort holding Friday's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle RC1 branch cut on each project's main cleanly through three holiday-equivalent days without further churn, with the cohort treating the RC1 cut plus the now-triply-aged nine-document reference set as the canonical closing federal observance stable snapshot the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday release-cycle execution week will resume against. The DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated Python-and-Rust reference-implementation index continues to ship the Friday-morning supplementary tag bundling the workshop-extension companion alongside the workshop-consolidation companion, the operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion, the applied-deployment evaluation companion, and the consolidation survey as the canonical five-paper deployment reference unchanged through the third holiday-equivalent day. The vLLM v0.11.4 stable build held its seventh full operating day with no escalations from the maintainer cohort and the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance suite holds green for an eighth consecutive day on the nine-document end-to-end conformance run across Codex CLI, Claude Code 3.0, Mistral Workflows, Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI Agent Governance Center, and Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry. The structural force is that once the nine-document reference set sits triply-aged through a closing federal observance with the maintainer cohort holding RC1 branch cuts cleanly through three holiday-equivalent days without churn, the consolidated reference-implementation index extending to cover the workshop-extension companion, the vLLM stable build holding its seventh operating day with no escalations, the cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance suite holding green for an eighth consecutive day on the nine-document conformance run, and the federal-civilian directive plus the FMRB executive instrument both sitting as triply-aged settled regulatory anchors, the promotion from RC-runway to settled default-shipment anchor compresses to post-Memorial-Day release-engineering arithmetic rather than an unresolved verification question. The most likely landing is the nine-document reference set shipping as the default verification surface bundle inside the mid-June default-shipment window, with each of the five framework projects tagging stable from their Friday RC1 branches inside the mid-June release window, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the same first week of June with default support, and the cleared CISA compliance-monitoring phase plus the cleared FMRB executive instrument cited together as the triply-aged triply-cleared regulatory backdrop the framework default-shipment commitment can lean on without overhanging risk-factor questions. Bear case is that one of the five RC1 branches logs a schema-drift regression during the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday-through-Friday dry-run week and the default-shipment slips one minor release cycle into late June; absent that slip, mid-June 2026 lands the nine-document reference set as the framework default-shipment anchor.
